about.title: Commerce Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Commerce is a small city — about 13,081 residents in Los Angeles County — but the I-5 Santa Ana Freeway and Telegraph Road carry traffic well beyond its size. In 2025, public records list 254 injury collisions here, with 333 people hurt and 2 lives lost. Behind each of those two numbers is a family working out what comes next. A wrongful death claim is the civil path for that family, and it is separate from any criminal case. Under California law, a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to bring it, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The claim can cover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Timing matters: generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. We handle these cases on contingency and can review your family's situation at no charge.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in Commerce Choose Us

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, then certain dependents and heirs. We can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: The deadline is tracked from day one
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter if a city, county, or state agency is involved. Starting early means those dates are not missed.

items.title: Every category of loss is accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Our fee is contingent, so there is no charge unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our family member was killed in a crash on the I-5 through Commerce. Where do we start?
items.answer: Start by gathering what you can: the CHP or police report number, the date and location, and any medical or funeral records. Then contact us so we can review how the collision happened and who may be responsible. If a public agency had any role, the filing window is shorter than two years, so it helps to begin sooner rather than later.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from any criminal prosecution. The two-year deadline keeps running regardless of the criminal case, and a criminal conviction is not required to pursue civil compensation.

items.question: Do you charge anything to review our case?
items.answer: No. We offer a free consultation, and we handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning your family pays no fee unless there is a recovery.
